title: dot-me identity.yaml
description: Schema for ~/.me/identity.yaml. Tracks SPEC.md §5.A. Required: name. location.timezone is required when location is present. additionalProperties is true everywhere per SPEC §5.6 (unknown keys MUST be tolerated by consumers).

name.description: Required. The user's full name as they want it referenced. SPEC §5.1.

preferred_name.description: How to address the user in prose.

nickname.description: Informal short label. vCard NICKNAME / FOAF foaf:nick.

email.description: Primary contact email. vCard EMAIL / Schema.org email.

website.description: Canonical homepage URI. vCard URL / Schema.org url.

avatar.description: Profile image URI. vCard PHOTO / Schema.org image / OIDC picture.

handle.description: Legacy single-handle field (v0.1). New producers SHOULD use social_profiles instead. When both are present, social_profiles is authoritative (SPEC §5.1).

social_profiles.description: List of social accounts. JSON Resume basics.profiles shape.

headline.description: Professional label. JSON Resume basics.label / Schema.org jobTitle.

spec_version.description: Optional but recommended. Pins the dot-me spec version this file targets.

location.description: When location is present, timezone is required. SPEC §5.1.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'America/Chicago'). Validators that support the 'iana-time-zone' format SHOULD check against tzdata; the pattern is a structural fallback.

country.description: SPEC §5.1 SHOULD: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'US', 'GB'). Left unconstrained at the schema layer so SHOULD-level guidance isn't hardened into install-time rejection.

languages.description: SPEC §5.1 SHOULD: BCP 47 language tags (Schema.org knowsLanguage). Item pattern is left unconstrained at the schema layer so SHOULD-level guidance isn't hardened into install-time rejection.

knows_about.description: Schema.org knowsAbout. Domain expertise topics. NOT spoken languages — use 'languages' for those.

work.description: Current roles only (v0.3). Use past_work for history.

project.description: Use instead of org for OSS / personal work.

past_work.description: Historical roles (v0.3+). Different update cadence + field set than current work.

start.description: Four-digit year as string or integer. Optional; omit if unknown.

end.description: Four-digit year or the literal 'present'. Optional.

projects.description: Personal / OSS projects worth surfacing. Not in §5.1 but common in adopter files.

family.description: May be deferred to v1 (encrypted-vault story). Schema permits the field today.

inner_circle.description: May be deferred to v1 for free-text notes; v0.3 carries name + role + optional handles map.

handles.description: Platform-key -> handle map. Known keys SHOULD be lowercase platform names. Values for social-platform keys SHOULD be bare handles (no '@', no full URL); website is the URI exception; email is the address exception.
